Package view

Class AnimationManager

java.lang.Object
view.AnimationManager
public class AnimationManager extends Object
The AnimationManager loads all existing animations into the game at start, keeping them available to be played.

  • Constructor Details

    • AnimationManager

      public AnimationManager()
      Extracts the animations from the given path, using the methods defined in the Animation class, putting each in the respective map. Each key of the Map is built using the Character's CharacterState and Direction enumerators.

  • Method Details

      public Animation getProjectileAnimation(Character shooter, Character.Direction direction)
